import os
import json
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.json"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.json"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/submission.csv"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(SUBMISSION_DIR), exist_ok=True)

# --- Loading Data ---
with open(TRAIN_PATH, "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open(TEST_PATH, "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

print(f"Loaded train: {len(train_df)} rows, test: {len(test_df)} rows")

# --- Feature Engineering & Preprocessing ---
NUM_FEATURES = [
    "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
]

TEXT_COLS = ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]


def preprocess_row(row):
    res = row.copy()

    # Handle boolean post_was_edited
    raw_val = res.get("post_was_edited", False)
    if isinstance(raw_val, bool):
        res["post_was_edited"] = int(1 if raw_val else 0)
    elif isinstance(raw_val, str) and raw_val.lower() == "true":
        res["post_was_edited"] = 1
    else:
        res["post_was_edited"] = 0

    # Handle list subreddits
    subs = res.get("requester_subreddits_at_request", [])
    if isinstance(subs, list):
        res["requester_subreddits_at_request"] = ",".join(str(x) for x in subs)
    else:
        res["requester_subreddits_at_request"] = ""

    # Convert all numeric features safely
    for col in NUM_FEATURES:
        val = res.get(col, 0.0)
        if val is not None:
            try:
                res[col] = float(val)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                res[col] = 0.0
        else:
            res[col] = 0.0

    # Ensure text fields are strings
    text_str = str(res.get("request_text_edit_aware", "")).strip().lower()
    title_str = str(res.get("request_title", "")).strip().lower()
    combined_text = text_str + " " + title_str

    # Character features
    res["char_count"] = len(combined_text) if combined_text else 0
    res["word_count"] = len(combined_text.split()) if combined_text else 0
    res["avg_char_len"] = res["char_count"] / max(res["word_count"], 1)

    # Punctuation features
    res["has_question_mark"] = int(1 if "?" in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_exclamation"] = int(1 if "!" in combined_text else 0)
    res["period_count"] = combined_text.count(".")
    res["colon_count"] = combined_text.count(":")
    res["has_comma"] = int(1 if "," in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_newline"] = int(1 if "\n" in text_str else 0)

    # Lexical diversity
    words = combined_text.split()
    unique_words = set(words)
    res["unique_word_ratio"] = len(unique_words) / max(len(words), 1)

    # Common pizza-related indicators
    res["has_word_kind"] = int(1 if "kind" in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_word_pizza"] = int(1 if "pizza" in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_word_favor"] = int(1 if "favor" in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_word_polite"] = int(
        1
        if any(
            p in combined_text
            for p in ["please", "thank", "thanks", "very", "so", "truly"]
        )
        else 0
    )
    res["has_word_good"] = int(1 if "good" in combined_text else 0)
    res["has_word_delicious"] = int(1 if "delicious" in combined_text else 0)

    # Safe interaction features
    req_comments = res.get("request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval", 0)
    usr_comments = res.get("requester_number_of_comments_at_request", 0)
    res["interaction_comment_ratio"] = req_comments / max(usr_comments, 1)

    return pd.Series(res)


# Apply processing to both datasets
train_processed = train_df.apply(preprocess_row, axis=1).reset_index(drop=True)
test_processed = test_df.apply(preprocess_row, axis=1).reset_index(drop=True)

# Get target variable - only exists in train data
y_train = train_processed["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(float)

# Check text column existence
all_text_cols_exist = True
for col in TEXT_COLS:
    if col not in train_processed.columns:
        all_text_cols_exist = False
        break

if not all_text_cols_exist:
    print("WARNING: Some text columns may be missing!")
    print(
        f"Available text cols in train: {train_processed.columns.str.contains('text', case=False, na=False).tolist()}"
    )
    print(
        f"Available text cols in test: {test_processed.columns.str.contains('text', case=False, na=False).tolist()}"
    )

# Build complete feature lists including all engineered features
text_extra_cols = [
    "char_count",
    "word_count",
    "avg_char_len",
    "has_question_mark",
    "has_exclamation",
    "period_count",
    "colon_count",
    "has_comma",
    "has_newline",
    "unique_word_ratio",
    "has_word_kind",
    "has_word_pizza",
    "has_word_favor",
    "has_word_polite",
    "has_word_good",
    "has_word_delicious",
    "interaction_comment_ratio",
    "post_was_edited",
    "requester_subreddits_at_request",
]

text_cols_present = []
for col in TEXT_COLS:
    if col in train_processed.columns:
        text_cols_present.append(col)

# Fit TF-IDF on train - properly pass text values as list, not DataFrame
if text_cols_present:
    X_train_text = tfidf.fit_transform(train_processed[text_cols_present])
else:
    print("ERROR: No text columns found for TF-IDF fitting")
    X_train_text = np.array([[]])

X_test_text = tfidf.transform(
    test_processed[text_cols_present]
    if len(text_cols_present) > 0
    else pd.DataFrame(columns=[""])
)

X_train_text_array = X_train_text.toarray()
X_test_text_array = X_test_text.toarray()

print(
    f"TF-IDF shape train: {X_train_text_array.shape}, test: {X_test_text_array.shape}"
)

# Extract all engineered features consistently
X_train_text_extra = (
    train_processed[text_extra_cols].to_numpy()
    if text_extra_cols and text_cols_present
    else np.array([[]]).T
)
X_test_text_extra = (
    test_processed[text_extra_cols].to_numpy()
    if text_cols_present
    else np.array([[]]).T
)

print(
    f"Extra features shape train: {X_train_text_extra.shape}, test: {X_test_text_extra.shape}"
)

# Combine text features and extra features
X_train_full = np.hstack([X_train_text_array, X_train_text_extra])
X_test_full = np.hstack([X_test_text_array, X_test_text_extra])

print(
    f"Full feature matrix shape train: {X_train_full.shape}, test: {X_test_full.shape}"
)

# Split features
X_train, X_val = X_train_full[:0], (
    X_train_full[0:1] if len(X_train_full) > 1 else X_train_full[:]
)

# Hold-out validation set (genuine split that never touches training)
split_idx = int(0.2 * len(X_train_full))
X_train_final = X_train_full[:split_idx]
y_train_final = y_train[:split_idx]
X_val = X_train_full[split_idx : split_idx + int(split_idx // 10)]
y_val = y_train[split_idx : split_idx + int(split_idx // 10)]

# Cross-validation for validation
cv_scores = cross_val_score(
    GradientBoostingClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        max_depth=6,
        min_samples_leaf=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=False,
    ),
    X_train_full,
    y_train,
    cv=KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
    scoring="roc_auc",
)

print(f"CV Mean AUC-ROC: {np.mean(cv_scores):.6f} (+/- {np.std(cv_scores)*2:.6f})")

# Train final model on pure training data (no validation contamination)
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    min_samples_leaf=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)
model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

# Evaluate on true hold-out validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_val:.6f}")

# Generate submission for test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "request_id": test_processed["request_id"],
        "requester_received_pizza": y_test_pred.round(6),
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_DIR, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to: {SUBMISSION_DIR}")
